plain.li: Nobody calls me {TITLE} any more. I hadn't noticed how much I liked it until it stopped.
I'm not {TITLE} now. The work I did is still mine.
Someone said my name at supper today, just my name. I used to be {TITLE}.

warm.li: They don't call me {TITLE} any more. It was kind of them while it lasted.

blunt.li: Not {TITLE} any more. Fine. I'll get on with things.

cheerful.li: So I'm not {TITLE} now. I'll just have to earn something better!

gloomy.li: They've stopped calling me {TITLE}. Even that didn't last.

cold.li: The colony no longer calls me {TITLE}. Names come and go; what I did stays done.
